text:
eva: heads-up — JS SDK publish failed the release gate. regen diff showed only ordering and a type->alias cosmetic change. publish bot still classified it as a minor.
ci-bot: job #4992 failed at release: https://ci.example.com/4992 (exit 1)
tony: minimal snippet:```diff
- export interface Session { expiresAt?: string; id: string }
+ export type Session = Readonly<{ id: string; expiresAt?: string }>
```semver-check flagged "minor" because interface->type.
ritesh: two quick fixes: (1) normalization step before semver check to canonicalize to interfaces, (2) CI gate that labels regen-only diffs and blocks auto-release.
eva: also seeing onboarding e2e flake: auth retry mutates headers on retry which fails our equality asserts.
ritesh: I'll add a normalize script `tools/normalize-gen.js` and wire it into `release/semver-check`. will also add a regen-only detector that looks for only generated/ changes.
tony: I'll update tests to clone headers before retry. small PRs from both of us.
qa-bot: created issue #1102 "regen-only diffs cause spurious minor releases" and added CI log.
release-bot: auto-release paused while label "regen-only" present on PR.
eva: plan: land test fix + normalize + CI gate, then unpin the typegen upgrade. target: tomorrow morning. thx :pray:
